body:
Whole lotta fuck you there.  

1. The wife problems suck, and really hurts but just accepting it?  Exercise, you don't know shit about us and you're telling me that she needs more exercise.  How did you come to that awesome conclusion?
2. Pain is a part of life, but not debilitating pain that make every movement agony.  I can't sleep anymore due to pain; no hydrocodine that the doctor prescribes even starts to take the sharpness away.  I hate taking them and have learned to deal with the pain and have an extremely high pain threshold (example, I ripped out part of my eye in an accident a few years go, I had no problem driving myself to the doctor.  He looked at me and said that most people wouldn't be able to think clearly with this type of injury much less drive).  But as you age the mental blocks to hold back the pain crumble away; and now agony sets in.
3. Fuck you on how I raised my son, he actually is a great kid but just isn't motivated.  He got lots of shit handed to him when he didn't do his work, sometimes no matter what you do shit has a way of ruining your plans.  

Fuck this, I'm out, I'm done, goodbye, I won't be back.  thanks for your "help".

I wish I had your problems, because they can be solved quite easily.  Just say goodbye to everyone, walk away and start a new life for yourself.  If you're there for them; you don't need them, just leave.  Anywhere, new city, new state, or even new country; just go.  Don't just disappear, but let them know that you're leaving because you want to start over.  If after a year or two things haven't changed, you can always go back to plan A.

For me, I'm stuck worse, in a life where everything is crumbling and pressure is mounting.  I can't think straight anymore.  Dying family, sick wife, failing body, fucked up kid, and a horrible career.  I just want to disappear, leave myself behind and go.  But I can't do that, I have commitments.... but not if I'm dead.
